reference_likeness.reason: Frank has not approved reference likeness. Technical tests cannot supply creative approval.

silhouette.reason: Youthful face, shoulder/sleeve construction, costume layering and footwear remain materially simpler than the reference.

face.reason: Inset eyes and rebuilt orbital rim improve seating/blink coverage. Skull/nose/lips remain generic, brow and speech expression weak; no complete oral cavity or recorded speech performance.

hands_digits.reason: Five original digit chains retained and palm/digits now share a real surface. The broad palm-to-finger crease, stubby digits, thumb opposition, knuckles and curled wrist remain mechanical.

prop_contact.reason: 58 visible ledger frames and 1728 sampled hand vertices/frame avoid the conservative page core. Cover/clasp/edges and natural palm/thumb contact are not certified; grip remains stiff and pickup/stow/blends need work.

clothing_deformation.reason: Sleeve proximal fit/weights and sash surface changed, but shoulder/wrist joins, hard sleeve folds and stiff cloth remain visible under reach/gesture.

limb_deformation.reason: Original 46 rest bones and finite normalized weights retained. Extreme wrist/ankle and elbow shape retention remain unconvincing; sampled poses are not approved full joint limits.

material_quality.reason: Skin/eye roughness, cloth weave and sash pattern revised. Close lighting still reveals flat clothing/skin, simplified pouches/sandals and insufficient reference textile detail.

cinematic_readability.reason: Frontal camera/exposure now controlled, but native skin/ledger remain too dark and glossy; close shots still expose generic facial forms, palm crease, stiff ledger grip and sleeve construction.

gameplay_readability.reason: Actual packaged movement and character-specific motion execute; intentional pose/expression/costume readability remains a human review gate.

source_scene_verified.reason: Exact editable scene verified; 46 unchanged rest bones, 11 retained actions, normalized finite weights and source/native posed probes pass. Actual solid/topology/skeleton/weight views exist.

package_verified.reason: Exact fresh candidate rendered scenario, checked actual asset binding, assertions and normal process exit.

rig.units: Native Unreal centimetres; rotations xyzw quaternion; local parent frame
